# 数据与统计

## 概述

本章提供描述数据与统计结果所需的英语词汇，分为数据类型、统计术语、数据操作、报告与汇报四个部分。它解决的是"看到数字怎么说得清楚"的问题，从数据本身到分析动作再到向上汇报的表达都涵盖在内。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，方便在数据沟通中直接套用。建议先掌握数据类型和统计术语，再学习如何用规范句式汇报数据结论。

## 数据类型

| 词汇      | 词性 | 含义   | 常用搭配                                           |
| --------- | ---- | ------ | -------------------------------------------------- |
| metric    | n.   | 指标   | key metric, performance metric                     |
| indicator | n.   | 指标   | leading indicator, KPI (Key Performance Indicator) |
| benchmark | n.   | 基准   | industry benchmark, set a benchmark                |
| dataset   | n.   | 数据集 | training dataset, clean dataset                    |
| sample    | n.   | 样本   | sample size, random sample                         |
| variable  | n.   | 变量   | dependent variable, control variable               |

### 听说例句

> A: What metrics are we tracking for this feature? B: DAU, retention rate, and average session time. These are our key performance indicators.

> A: Is our sample size large enough? B: We have 50,000 users in the test group, which should give us statistically significant results.

### 写作表达

- The benchmark analysis revealed that our conversion rate is 15% above the industry average.
- A well-defined set of metrics ensures that progress can be measured objectively.

---

## 统计术语

| 词汇        | 词性    | 含义   | 常用搭配                                           |
| ----------- | ------- | ------ | -------------------------------------------------- |
| average     | n./adj. | 平均   | average value, on average                          |
| percentage  | n.      | 百分比 | high percentage, percentage increase               |
| ratio       | n.      | 比率   | click-through ratio, cost-to-revenue ratio         |
| trend       | n.      | 趋势   | upward trend, trend analysis                       |
| correlation | n.      | 相关性 | strong correlation, correlation between            |
| significant | adj.    | 显著的 | statistically significant, significant improvement |

### 听说例句

> A: Is there a correlation between push notifications and user engagement? B: Yes, the data shows a strong positive correlation. Users who opt in have 30% higher retention.

> A: Are the A/B test results significant? B: The p-value is below 0.05, so the improvement is statistically significant.

### 写作表达

- The trend analysis indicates a steady upward trajectory in monthly active users over the past six months.
- There is a significant correlation between response time and user satisfaction scores.

---

## 数据操作

| 词汇      | 词性    | 含义   | 常用搭配                             |
| --------- | ------- | ------ | ------------------------------------ |
| aggregate | v./adj. | 聚合   | aggregate data, in aggregate         |
| filter    | v.      | 筛选   | filter by date, filter out noise     |
| segment   | v./n.   | 分段   | segment users, user segment          |
| normalize | v.      | 标准化 | normalize data, normalized score     |
| visualize | v.      | 可视化 | visualize trends, data visualization |
| export    | v.      | 导出   | export to CSV, export report         |

### 听说例句

> A: Can we segment the users by region? B: Sure. I'll filter by country and aggregate the results into a dashboard.

> A: How should we present this data to the stakeholders? B: Let's visualize the key trends in a chart and export the raw data as a backup.

### 写作表达

- The data was aggregated across all regions and normalized to account for seasonal fluctuations.
- User segmentation enables more targeted marketing strategies and personalized experiences.

---

## 报告与汇报

| 词汇           | 词性  | 含义 | 常用搭配                                           |
| -------------- | ----- | ---- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| report         | n./v. | 报告 | quarterly report, report findings                  |
| insight        | n.    | 洞察 | actionable insight, key insight                    |
| finding        | n.    | 发现 | research findings, key finding                     |
| conclusion     | n.    | 结论 | draw a conclusion, in conclusion                   |
| recommendation | n.    | 建议 | based on our recommendation, strong recommendation |
| forecast       | n./v. | 预测 | revenue forecast, forecast growth                  |

### 听说例句

> A: What were the key findings from the user research? B: The main insight is that users abandon checkout due to a lack of payment options.

> A: Can you share the revenue forecast for next quarter? B: Based on current trends, we forecast a 12% increase in revenue.

### 写作表达

- The quarterly report highlights three actionable insights for improving user retention.
- Based on our findings, we recommend expanding the product lineup to include mid-tier pricing options.
